Use case: precise-object-edit.
This is a magnified crop of a game sprite. ERASE ONE LINE. The unwanted dark diagonal goes from approximately (105,130) down-right to the junction at (193,275) in this 512x512 crop. Fill over them with the surrounding side-panel color, making the area on both sides of that obsolete line one continuous uninterrupted face.

Same exact crop, framing, shapes and palette everywhere else. Do not sharpen, enlarge, reframe or redesign. No text or marks. Output the edited crop only.
Maintain the existing blue color.
